onset.Description: Event onset relative to the beginning of the corresponding functional run

trial_type.Description: Type of stimulus presented during the event. Values beginning with odor_ indicate odor stimuli; values beginning with image_ indicate visual image stimuli. The number indicates the stimulus identity.

stimulus_number.Description: Numeric identifier of the presented odor or image stimulus.

response_made.Description: Whether the participant made a behavioral response during the trial.

response_key.Description: Key pressed by the participant when a response was made; n/a indicates no response.

response_time.Description: Response time relative to event onset; n/a indicates no response.
